description: Set workspace exclusions from organisation-wide input guardrails. Each entry excludes or restores one workspace; override_existing replaces prior states while the default merge behavior preserves unmentioned workspaces. Review the matching list tool first because enforcement changes immediately. Repeating the same states is safe. Requires an organisation service API key with organisation_exclusions.update scope. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

organisation_id.description: Organisation ID whose workspace exclusions should be updated

override_existing.description: Replace existing exclusion states instead of merging changes

excluded.description: True to exclude this workspace; false to restore enforcement

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID whose exclusion state changes

name: update_input_guardrail_workspace_exclusions

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
